mapper.sql: SELECT 'PAYMENT_ATTEMPT' AS flow_source, pa.attempt_no AS flow_no, pa.payment_order_id, po.order_no, pa.prepay_order_no, '支付尝试' AS flow_type, 'info' AS flow_type_tag, pa.channel_code, pa.terminal, pa.client_ip, pa.idempotency_key, pa.attempt_status AS business_status, pa.attempt_status_type AS business_status_type, NULL AS notify_type, NULL AS route_rule, NULL AS downstream_system, NULL AS event_topic, NULL AS publish_status, NULL AS retry_count, pa.request_payload, pa.response_payload, CONCAT('方式=', pa.payment_method, ' / 状态=', pa.attempt_status) AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(pa.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, 1 AS flow_source_rank, pa.id AS flow_source_id FROM t_payment_attempt pa LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id UNION ALL SELECT 'CHANNEL_NOTIFY' AS flow_source, pnl.notify_no AS flow_no, pnl.payment_order_id, po.order_no, NULL AS prepay_order_no, '渠道回调' AS flow_type, 'warn' AS flow_type_tag, pnl.channel_code, NULL AS terminal, NULL AS client_ip, NULL AS idempotency_key, pnl.notify_status AS business_status, pnl.notify_status_type AS business_status_type, pnl.notify_type, NULL AS route_rule, NULL AS downstream_system, NULL AS event_topic, NULL AS publish_status, NULL AS retry_count, pnl.notify_payload AS request_payload, pnl.notify_result AS response_payload, CONCAT('类型=', pnl.notify_type, ' / 状态=', pnl.notify_status) AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(pnl.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, 2 AS flow_source_rank, pnl.id AS flow_source_id FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pnl.payment_order_id UNION ALL SELECT 'ROUTE_RECORD' AS flow_source, prr.route_no AS flow_no, prr.payment_order_id, po.order_no, pa.prepay_order_no, '路由记录' AS flow_type, 'info' AS flow_type_tag, prr.channel_code, pa.terminal, pa.client_ip, pa.idempotency_key, prr.route_result AS business_status, 'info' AS business_status_type, NULL AS notify_type, prr.route_rule, NULL AS downstream_system, NULL AS event_topic, NULL AS publish_status, NULL AS retry_count, NULL AS request_payload, NULL AS response_payload, CONCAT('规则=', prr.route_rule, ' / 结果=', prr.route_result) AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(prr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, 3 AS flow_source_rank, prr.id AS flow_source_id FROM t_payment_route_record prr LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = prr.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN t_payment_attempt pa ON pa.attempt_no = prr.attempt_no UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS_EVENT' AS flow_source, pe.event_no AS flow_no, pe.payment_order_id, pe.biz_no AS order_no, NULL AS prepay_order_no, '业务事件' AS flow_type, 'success' AS flow_type_tag, po.channel_code, NULL AS terminal, NULL AS client_ip, NULL AS idempotency_key, pe.event_type AS business_status, CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' THEN 'success' WHEN pe.event_type = 'PAYMENT_CLOSED' THEN 'danger' ELSE 'info' END AS business_status_type, NULL AS notify_type, NULL AS route_rule, pe.downstream_system, pe.event_topic, pe.publish_status, pe.retry_count, pe.event_payload AS request_payload, NULL AS response_payload, CONCAT('事件=', pe.event_type, ' / 发布=', pe.publish_status) AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(pe.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, 4 AS flow_source_rank, pe.id AS flow_source_id FROM t_payment_event pe LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pe.payment_order_id

if.test: query.flowType != null and query.flowType != '' and query.flowType != '全部'
query.terminal != null and query.terminal != '' and query.terminal != '全部'
query.businessStatus != null and query.businessStatus != '' and query.businessStatus != '全部'

where.if: AND (summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR request_payload LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR response_payload LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT flow_source AS flowSource, flow_no AS flowNo, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, order_no AS orderNo, prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, flow_type AS flowType, flow_type_tag AS flowTypeTag, channel_code AS channelCode, terminal, client_ip AS clientIp, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, business_status AS businessStatus, business_status_type AS businessStatusType, notify_type AS notifyType, route_rule AS routeRule, downstream_system AS downstreamSystem, event_topic AS eventTopic, publish_status AS publishStatus, retry_count AS retryCount, request_payload AS requestPayload, response_payload AS responsePayload, summary, created_at AS createdAt FROM () payment_flow_union
LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT flow_source AS flowSource, flow_no AS flowNo, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, order_no AS orderNo, prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, flow_type AS flowType, flow_type_tag AS flowTypeTag, channel_code AS channelCode, terminal, client_ip AS clientIp, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, business_status AS businessStatus, business_status_type AS businessStatusType, notify_type AS notifyType, route_rule AS routeRule, downstream_system AS downstreamSystem, event_topic AS eventTopic, publish_status AS publishStatus, retry_count AS retryCount, request_payload AS requestPayload, response_payload AS responsePayload, summary, created_at AS createdAt FROM () payment_flow_union
LIMIT 1001

choose.when: SELECT 'PAYMENT_ATTEMPT' AS flowSource, pa.attempt_no AS flowNo, pa.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, po.order_no AS orderNo, standard_order.order_no AS standardOrderNo, pa.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, pr.bill_no AS billNo, pa.attempt_no AS paymentRequestNo, attempt_route.route_no AS routeNo, attempt_route.route_result AS routeResult, '支付尝试' AS flowType, 'info' AS flowTypeTag, pa.payment_method AS paymentMethod, pa.source_app_id AS sourceAppId, pa.channel_code AS channelCode, pa.terminal, pa.client_ip AS clientIp, pa.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, pa.attempt_status AS businessStatus, pa.attempt_status_type AS businessStatusType, NULL AS notifyType, attempt_route.route_rule AS routeRule, NULL AS downstreamSystem, NULL AS eventTopic, NULL AS publishStatus, NULL AS retryCount, pa.ops_config_snapshot_version AS opsConfigSnapshotVersion, pa.request_payload AS requestPayload, pa.response_payload AS responsePayload, CONCAT('方式=', pa.payment_method, ' / 状态=', pa.attempt_status) AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(pa.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS completedAt, DATE_FORMAT(pa.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_payment_attempt pa LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = po.order_no LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.prepay_order_no = pa.prepay_order_no LEFT JOIN t_payment_route_record attempt_route ON attempt_route.id = ( SELECT prr.id FROM t_payment_route_record prr WHERE prr.attempt_no = pa.attempt_no ORDER BY prr.created_at DESC, prr.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE pa.attempt_no = #{flowNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT 'CHANNEL_NOTIFY' AS flowSource, pnl.notify_no AS flowNo, pnl.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, po.order_no AS orderNo, standard_order.order_no AS standardOrderNo, NULL AS prepayOrderNo, NULL AS billNo, NULL AS paymentRequestNo, NULL AS routeNo, NULL AS routeResult, '渠道回调' AS flowType, 'warn' AS flowTypeTag, po.payment_method AS paymentMethod, NULL AS sourceAppId, pnl.channel_code AS channelCode, NULL AS terminal, NULL AS clientIp, NULL AS idempotencyKey, pnl.notify_status AS businessStatus, pnl.notify_status_type AS businessStatusType, pnl.notify_type AS notifyType, NULL AS routeRule, NULL AS downstreamSystem, NULL AS eventTopic, NULL AS publishStatus, NULL AS retryCount, NULL AS opsConfigSnapshotVersion, pnl.notify_payload AS requestPayload, pnl.notify_result AS responsePayload, CONCAT('类型=', pnl.notify_type, ' / 状态=', pnl.notify_status) AS summary, NULL AS completedAt, DATE_FORMAT(pnl.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pnl.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = po.order_no WHERE pnl.notify_no = #{flowNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT 'ROUTE_RECORD' AS flowSource, prr.route_no AS flowNo, prr.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, po.order_no AS orderNo, standard_order.order_no AS standardOrderNo, pa.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, pr.bill_no AS billNo, prr.attempt_no AS paymentRequestNo, prr.route_no AS routeNo, prr.route_result AS routeResult, '路由记录' AS flowType, 'info' AS flowTypeTag, po.payment_method AS paymentMethod, pa.source_app_id AS sourceAppId, prr.channel_code AS channelCode, pa.terminal, pa.client_ip AS clientIp, pa.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, prr.route_result AS businessStatus, 'info' AS businessStatusType, NULL AS notifyType, prr.route_rule AS routeRule, NULL AS downstreamSystem, NULL AS eventTopic, NULL AS publishStatus, NULL AS retryCount, prr.ops_config_snapshot_version AS opsConfigSnapshotVersion, NULL AS requestPayload, NULL AS responsePayload, CONCAT('规则=', prr.route_rule, ' / 结果=', prr.route_result) AS summary, NULL AS completedAt, DATE_FORMAT(prr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_payment_route_record prr LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = prr.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN t_payment_attempt pa ON pa.attempt_no = prr.attempt_no LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.prepay_order_no = pa.prepay_order_no LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = po.order_no WHERE prr.route_no = #{flowNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT 'BUSINESS_EVENT' AS flowSource, pe.event_no AS flowNo, pe.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, pe.biz_no AS orderNo, standard_order.order_no AS standardOrderNo, NULL AS prepayOrderNo, NULL AS billNo, NULL AS paymentRequestNo, NULL AS routeNo, NULL AS routeResult, '业务事件' AS flowType, 'success' AS flowTypeTag, po.payment_method AS paymentMethod, NULL AS sourceAppId, po.channel_code AS channelCode, NULL AS terminal, NULL AS clientIp, NULL AS idempotencyKey, pe.event_type AS businessStatus, CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' THEN 'success' WHEN pe.event_type = 'PAYMENT_CLOSED' THEN 'danger' ELSE 'info' END AS businessStatusType, NULL AS notifyType, NULL AS routeRule, pe.downstream_system AS downstreamSystem, pe.event_topic AS eventTopic, pe.publish_status AS publishStatus, pe.retry_count AS retryCount, NULL AS opsConfigSnapshotVersion, pe.event_payload AS requestPayload, NULL AS responsePayload, CONCAT('事件=', pe.event_type, ' / 发布=', pe.publish_status) AS summary, NULL AS completedAt, DATE_FORMAT(pe.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_payment_event pe LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pe.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = pe.biz_no WHERE pe.event_no = #{flowNo} LIMIT 1
